goal: Validate declared material sources and CSP automatically during every build.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Inspect catalog loaders, current CSP and build pipeline before fixing the shared declaration contract.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: One feature owner delegated the registry/provider integration; root authored independent production-browser checks and a separate reviewer audited the implementation.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Registry and provider files had one writer; validator/build/docs had one writer; root owned browser tests and this report.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: One coupled feature owner, one registry worker, independent read-only review and root verification.

scope.policyPermissions: Existing CSP remains byte-identical; Workbox matching uses exact trusted origins.
scope.textOnlyReason: Removed declarations for six nonexistent image variants. Existing optional-reference fallback is preserved.

browserTests.productionPolicyChecks: Eight allowed connection origins, allowed hosted image, blocked undeclared fetch/image before network, all eight shipped material SVGs load.

verification.independentReview: Confirmed fixes for missing built assets, inactive CSP markup and ANALYZE environment scoping. No outstanding confirmed defects.

limitations: The inventory covers declared catalogs, not arbitrary future application source or dynamic provider result URLs.
Current catalog loaders accept local public assets; remote catalog URLs fail instead of automatically gaining CSP permissions.
Attribution URLs are validated as metadata and never grant network access.
HTML checking covers generated application shells; immutable third-party Taste demos and optional analyzer HTML are outside that set.
No layout changes were made; verification targeted source integrity, production CSP and existing provider/material workflows.
